name: תוכי פרינט — בונה הקטלוג
tagline_en: A self-updating product catalog builder for a print shop
type: Hebrew-RTL catalog builder / order tool (single-file interactive demo)
summary_he: מסך עבודה אחד לבחירת מוצרים לקטלוג העונתי: מחיר ליחידה ומחיר לכמות, שער חגיגי, קטלוג מסודר לפי קטגוריה וטופס הזמנה ללקוח, מוכן לשליחה בכמה נגיעות.
summary_en: One screen to pick this season's catalog products (per-unit and bulk price), producing a festive cover, a category-sorted catalog, and a client order form ready to send.
screens: בונה הקטלוג (builder: products, prices, categories, search/filter, add product, contact)
שער הקטלוג (festive cover + catalog pages grouped by category)
טופס הזמנה (client order form with quantities, tier pricing, totals + VAT)
features: Pick catalog items with a single toggle; selection drives every screen
Inline-editable product title; per-unit and bulk (25+) price fields
Category grouping with search and a category filter
Add a product on the fly; edit business contact details
Festive cover with logo, tagline, contact, voucher/CTA badges
Order form with quantity-aware pricing and totals, VAT toggle
Dual Gregorian + Hebrew date on the cover
Continuous autosave indicator; live selection summary bar
highlights: One in-memory selection is the single source of truth across builder, cover and order form.
Pure quantity-aware pricing function (bulk from 25 units) with safe fallbacks.
Whole product grid runs on one delegated event handler — no per-card listeners.
Hebrew + Gregorian dating via the browser's Intl Hebrew calendar, no date library.
privacy_note: Products, prices, phone and email are example data only. The demo runs client-side and calls no external services.
